title: Import Map Specifier Resolution & Scopes
description: Trace how the browser registers an import map, resolves scoped bare specifiers, and avoids waterfalls.

steps.label: 1. Parse Import Map Before Modules
steps.description: HTML parser ingests <script type='importmap'> into the document's module resolution table.

steps.label: 2. Longest-Prefix Scope Lookup
steps.description: Module /legacy/app.js imports 'lit'; engine checks scopes['/legacy/'] before falling back to top-level imports.

steps.label: 3. Preloaded Graph Instantiation
steps.description: Because modulepreload fetched /cdn/lit.3.2.1.js in parallel with HTML, main app instantiates with zero waterfall.
